Somewhere between strength 0.5-1.0 the results become anatomically implausible. By 2.0 you're deep into Toontown. Also, at higher strengths exposed midriffs will become toned (not jacked) and plasticky - nature of the dataset.

Negative strength adds chub, not flub.
